modifications: No upstream source or binary changes. Separate launch.py applies Landlock and seccomp restrictions and prevents user Lua loading.
configuration: The runtime launches the editor in DATA_DIR/workspace with configuration at DATA_DIR/config. User Lua locations are replaced by dangling links before startup; built-in functionality remains. Landlock allows data access only to the instance and terminal, and only the editor binary may execute. seccomp blocks execve. Installed executables remain root-owned mode 0555. Before confinement the launcher creates mode-0111 executable copies under private TMPDIR; Landlock permits executing those copies and denies access to the installed implementation.
